name: 中国移动云盘
text:
#!name=中国移动云盘
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule


[Rule]
DOMAIN, ad.mcloud.139.com,REJECT

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mcmm\.caiyun\.feixin\.10086\.cn:80\/mcmm\/api\/IAdvert/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mcmm\.caiyun\.feixin\.10086\.cn:80\/mcmm\/api\/v\d\/getAdverts/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/middle\.yun\.139\.com\/openapi\/cardConfig\/queryCardInfoV3/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ad\.mcloud\.139\.com\/advertapi\/adv-filter\/adv-filter\/AdInfoFilter\/getAdInfos/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mrp\.mcloud\.139\.com\/mc\/mc-client-service\/openapi\/letter\/query/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
移除开屏广告 = type=http-response, pattern=^https:\/\/jzts\.cmpassport\.com\/personalized\/getPushContent, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/mobileClouds/mobileClouds_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true
移除应用内广告 = type=http-response, pattern=^https:\/\/ad\.mcloud\.139\.com\/advertapi\/adv-filter\/, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/mobileClouds/mobileClouds_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% mcmm.caiyun.feixin.10086.cn, mrp.mcloud.139.com, ad.mcloud.139.com, middle.yun.139.com, jzts.cmpassport.com
